description.short_caption: Distended abdomen with visible skin changes and outstretched hands.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a distended abdomen with subtle skin changes, including faint discoloration and possible striae. The hands are outstretched, displaying no obvious lesions or abnormalities. The image suggests a systemic condition potentially involving abdominal distension, and the skin findings may hint at underlying pathology.

description.short_caption: Diffuse hyperpigmented macules on the palm and fingers.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the palmar surface of a hand with numerous small, hyperpigmented macules distributed diffusely across the palm and fingers. The lesions are uniform in size and appear to be non-raised. The background skin tone appears intact without signs of erythema or scaling. The image is well-lit, and the hand is positioned palm-up against a light blue background.
